english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an individual victory.
This is the all-purpose noun for a victory in a battle, competition, or successful effort.
This is the all-purpose noun for a military victory when the emphasis is on winning rather than subjugating the enemy.
Use this when the triumph is specifically a victory over an opponent or obstacle.
Use this when “glory” refers specifically to a victory or winning result.

examples.english: We finally got a win in this game.
examples.traditional: 今場波我哋終於攞到勝利。
